name: Tiled Separable Lorenzo Predictor
description: Dimension-aware tiled separable integer Lorenzo predictor (cuSZp3 delta). Within each fixed-size tile (default 8×8 in 2-D, 4×4×4 in 3-D) applies a separable integer Lorenzo: leading edges predict inward, each element predicts from its x-neighbor. Forward emits output in tile-major order so a downstream AdaptiveBitpackStage(blockSize=tileElems) packs each tile as one block, reproducing the cuSZp3 compression ratio. Lossless.

config.name: tileShape
config.description: Tile extents (tx, ty, tz). Defaults: 1-D=64, 2-D=8×8, 3-D=4×4×4. Product tx*ty*tz must be in [1, 1024]. Set via setTileShape(tx[, ty[, tz]]).

paper.title: GPU Lossy Compression for HPC Can Be Versatile and Ultra-Fast
paper.authors: Yafan Huang, Sheng Di, Guanpeng Li, Franck Cappello
